thread.title: Intel stock gains as Raymond James upgrades to market perform despite Apple concerns

author: morningstar.com
title: Intel stock gains as Raymond James upgrades to market perform despite Apple concerns
text:
Shares of Intel Corp. (INTC) are up 2.9% in premarket trading Monday after Raymond James analyst Chris Caso upgraded the stock to market perform from underperform. He points to a favorable supply/demand balance in the semiconductor industry. "While we still have long-term concerns, we don't see a near-term negative catalyst due to strengthening underlying business conditions," Caso wrote, adding that "an exception to the strong conditions is at Apple (AAPL), due to an unfavorable mix-shift for both existing products as well as for fall expectations." Caso also upgraded shares of Analog Devices Inc. (ADI) to outperform from market perform, writing that he sees the company's Apple headwind ending. Intel shares are up 40% over the past 12 months, while Analog Devices shares are down 1.5%. The S&P 500 Index has gained 10% over the past year, compared with a 32% rise for the PHLX Semiconductor Index .
-Emily Bary; 0849ET
